// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-RELATION
// The traversal is permitted only inside a where block, where it filters. In a
// select it returns child rows, which is the thing the rule is for.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function schoolRoll(schoolId) {
  return db.student.count({
    select: { class: { teacher: { schoolId } } },
  });
}
